text: For tokenized stocks, smart contracts can verify ownership and holding periods directly from blockchain ledgers and trigger voucher airdrops without intermediaries, which lowers operational costs and increases LER scalability.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Liquid Equity Rewards (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5454054
abstract: For tokenized NASDAQ stocks, smart contracts can query blockchain ledgers to verify ownership and holding periods. This triggers voucher reward airdrops without intermediaries. Whic, in turn, reduces operational costs and enhances LER scalability.
